Messages.Author: Tetragrammaton
Messages.Body:
Hi, i'm wondering why on the backgorund Ahrimanes' symbol
is not visible the sabbat wax seal.
They're are marked as "Sabbat", so the wax seal should be well present (and
visible)
on their clan symbol
(as it is with the Harbringers, ! Salubri, Blood Brothers and Kiasyd).

Is this a mistake?
Or i'm missing something?

Thanks in advance
Emiliano, vekn prince of Rome

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Tetragrammaton wrote:
>
> Hi, i'm wondering why on the backgorund Ahrimanes' symbol
> is not visible the sabbat wax seal.
> They're are marked as "Sabbat", so the wax seal should be well present (and
> visible)
> on their clan symbol

It is.

> (as it is with the Harbringers, ! Salubri, Blood Brothers and Kiasyd).

The wax seal is not shown on any of the clan symbols on the web page,
if that's what you're fretting over.

Or you may be referring to the pointy-compass/star thing as a "wax
symbol" (which it is not). The pointy star thing is primarily used
to designate an antitribu clan.

For instance, the Lasombra do not use the "antitribu" star.

So the better question would be: why to the Harbingers (only two 'r's
there, BTW), Blood Brothers, and Kiasyd use the antitribu star when
they're not antitribu? I do not know the answer - you'd have to ask
the main WoD designers.
